intro: Bingles Blastenheimer is an eccentric gnomish aviator stranded on the southeastern shores of the Loch in Loch Modan. Having crash-landed his experimental flying machine, he finds himself marooned amidst local troggs and beasts, desperate to salvage his precious tools and components.

p: Like many ambitious gnomish engineers, Bingles Blastenheimer took to the skies in a customized flying craft, only to discover that coming down safely is far more difficult than lifting off. After his gyrocopter malfunctioned and crashed into the southeastern shores of the Loch, Bingles survived the impact intact, but his machine shattered into scattered parts. Stranded far from Ironforge, he remains huddled near the wreckage, guarded against hungry crocolisks and hostile troggs while pleading with passing travelers to recover the tools and Blastencapper explosives that troggs from a nearby island stole from him.
